title: add an option to enable or disable scroll with mouse wheel when cursor is on virtual desktop pager
line: The Pager has a new "Scrolling switches virtual desktops" option, so scrolling over it by accident no longer flips desktops.
explanation: Scrolling over the Pager (and the Activity Pager) always switched desktops or activities, with no way to turn it off, unlike the Task Manager. It is easy to trigger by accident when a scrolled window is above the panel. The change adds a wheelEnabled config entry (default on), a checkbox in the General page, and disables the pager's wheel MouseArea when it is off; "Navigation wraps around" only affects scrolling, so it is greyed out when scrolling is off.

commits.message:
applets/pager: Add an option to turn off switching desktops by scrolling

Scrolling over the pager always switched desktops, which is easy to do
by accident when scrolling a window above the panel. Add an option to
turn it off, like the Task Manager has; wrap-around follows it.

BUG: 495062

patches.diff:
From a66582e5d8a9a86cfcf41d8878a751c998bb2301 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:30:00 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/pager: Add an option to turn off switching desktops
 by scrolling

Scrolling over the pager always switched desktops, which is easy to do
by accident when scrolling a window above the panel. Add an option to
turn it off, like the Task Manager has; wrap-around follows it.

BUG: 495062
---
 applets/pager/main.xml              | 4 ++++
 applets/pager/qml/configGeneral.qml | 7 +++++++
 applets/pager/qml/main.qml          | 1 +
 3 files changed, 12 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/pager/main.xml b/applets/pager/main.xml
index d47b935b1e..bf6fe8db73 100644
--- a/applets/pager/main.xml
+++ b/applets/pager/main.xml
@@ -27,6 +27,10 @@
       <label>Whether to limit the Pager to the set of windows and the geometry of the screen the widget resides on.</label>
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="wheelEnabled" type="Bool">
+        <label>Whether scrolling over the pager switches between pages</label>
+        <default>true</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="wrapPage" type="Bool">
         <label>Whether to wrap page when navigating with pager</label>
         <default>false</default>
diff --git a/applets/pager/qml/configGeneral.qml b/applets/pager/qml/configGeneral.qml
index 23074d9ab6..68a91556b9 100644
--- a/applets/pager/qml/configGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/pager/qml/configGeneral.qml
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
     property int cfg_currentDesktopSelected
     property alias cfg_pagerLayout: pagerLayout.currentIndex
     property alias cfg_showOnlyCurrentScreen: showOnlyCurrentScreen.checked
+    property alias cfg_wheelEnabled: wheelEnabled.checked
     property alias cfg_wrapPage: wrapPage.checked
 
     Kirigami.FormLayout {
@@ -52,9 +53,15 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show only current screen")
         }
 
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: wheelEnabled
+            text: root.isActivityPager ? i18nc("@option:check", "Scrolling switches activities") : i18nc("@option:check", "Scrolling switches virtual desktops")
+        }
+
         QQC2.CheckBox {
             id: wrapPage
             text: i18nc("@option:check", "Navigation wraps around")
+            enabled: wheelEnabled.checked
         }
 
 
diff --git a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
index b4211ddbbd..013fd3679d 100644
--- a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
@@ -96,6 +96,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
         acceptedButtons: Qt.NoButton
         hoverEnabled: true
+        enabled: Plasmoid.configuration.wheelEnabled
 
         onWheel: wheel => {
             // Magic number 120 for common "one click, see:
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Pager settings on master: no way to turn off scrolling
New "Scrolling switches virtual desktops" option, here unchecked; wrap-around greys out

review.text: Straightforward and well-scoped implementation of the requested Pager setting across main.xml, configGeneral.qml, and main.qml. Defaulting wheelEnabled to true preserves current behavior, the checkbox label adapts for Activity Pager as requested in follow-up comments, and disabling wrapPage when scrolling is off matches its sole usage in onWheel. Disabling rootMouseArea cleanly turns off wheel switching without affecting clicks, hover tooltips, or window drag-and-drop.
